paper_title: Electron Delocalization in a Rigid Cofacial Naphthalene-1,8:4,5-bis(dicarboximide) Dimer

knowledge_points.content: The NDI dimer 2NDI is synthesized via the condensation of naphthalenetetracarboxylic dianhydride with enantiopure trans-1,2-cyclohexanediamine in anhydrous DMF at 130 °C, yielding approximately 10% of the product.
knowledge_points.evidence: A solution of (RR)-trans-1,2-cyclohexanediamine... was added quickly to a solution of naphthalenetetracarboxylic dianhydride... at 130 °C... to afford pure (−)-2NDI... in 10% yield.

knowledge_points.content: Single crystals of the (−)-2NDI enantiomer belong to the triclinic space group P1, with unit cell parameters a = 7.0255 Å, b = 14.6532 Å, c = 22.0962 Å, and a calculated density of 1.543 g/cm³.
The NDI dimer (−)-2NDI exhibits an absolute photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 4.7 ± 0.6% in dichloromethane at 298 K.
knowledge_points.evidence: The absolute fluorescence quantum yield in CH2Cl2 at 298 K, determined by the use of an integrating sphere, was (4.7 ± 0.6)%.

knowledge_points.content: The excimer-like state of the (−)-2NDI dimer has a fluorescence lifetime (τ0) of 20.0 ± 0.1 ns in dichloromethane, as determined by time-correlated single photon counting (TCSPC).
knowledge_points.evidence: The excimer-like state lifetime was determined by the fluorescence decay... to give τ0 = 20.0 ± 0.1 ns.

knowledge_points.content: Electron delocalization in the [2NDI]•− radical anion is confirmed by the presence of an intervalence charge transfer (IVCT) band in the NIR region that is invariant with respect to solvent polarity.
knowledge_points.evidence: Moreover the IVCT band in the NIR is (Figure S4b) invariant upon solvent polarity change, which is consistent of delocalized character of the mixed valence state.

knowledge_points.content: CW-ENDOR spectroscopy reveals that the hyperfine coupling constant (HFCC) for the [2NDI]•− cyclophane is 2.56 MHz, which is roughly half the value of the monomeric Ref-NDI (5.28 MHz), indicating the electron is shared between two NDI units.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S8 shows a % reduction of the magnitude of the HFCCs for [2NDI]•− (2.56 MHz) relative to [Ref-NDI]•– (5.28 MHz).

knowledge_points.content: Single crystals of the dianion [(-)-2NDI]2− were grown under an Argon atmosphere using slow vapor diffusion of n-hexane into a 1.0 mM chloroform solution containing tetrabutylammonium counterions.
knowledge_points.evidence: Single crystals of [(−)/−2NDI]2− • 2Bu4N+ were grown in a glovebox under Argon atmosphere by slow vapor diffusion of n-hexane into a 1.0 mM solution in CHCl3.

knowledge_points.content: Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations for 2NDI in neutral, monoanionic, and dianionic forms were performed at the M06-2X/6-31G** level of theory using the Jaguar software package.
knowledge_points.evidence: Structures were optimized at the M06-2X[S5]/6-31G** level of theory in their neutral as well as their mono- and dianionic forms.

knowledge_points.content: Chemical reduction of 2NDI to its radical anion and dianion states was achieved using cobaltocene (CoCp2) as a one-electron reductant in a glovebox environment.
knowledge_points.evidence: The spectroscopic titration (Figure S4) of CoCp2 into a 10 μM solution of (−)-2NDI in CH2Cl2 was carried out in a glovebox under an Argon atmosphere.

knowledge_points.content: The crystal structure of (−)-2NDI exhibits C-H···O hydrogen bonds between adjacent molecules with a C···O distance of 3.0 Å and a H···O distance of 2.4 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: The C···O distance was 3.0 Å. The CH···O hydrogen bond was 2.4 Å. The angle at hydrogen was 120–123°.
